s: internship (job taken by a student), apprenticeship
a practical course as opposed to a theoretical one, work placement, practicum
Praktikum.et: From the neuter of Late Latin practicus (“practical”), from Ancient Greek πρακτικός (praktikós, “of or pertaining to action, concerned with action or business, active, practical”), from πράσσω (prássō, “I do”).

Präkambrium.et: From prä- (“pre-”) + Kambrium (“Cambrian”), a learned borrowing from New Latin Praecambrium.

praktikabel.et: Borrowed from French practicable, from Medieval Latin practicabilis.
